---
title: "Tools"
---

Two tools support calculation and reporting from declared posterior inputs.
[Supplied posterior summaries](your-data.qmd) or pairwise probabilities yield a coherent report with an explicit
search-family label. The calculation may enumerate a family, optimise cuts of one order or invoke the optional
joint solver. The [case-report tool](report-designer.qmd) uses released cases and retains the target definitions,
settings, denominators and computation scope in the reporting account. Both tools expose their applied inputs and
results and provide local downloads for reproduction.
